system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. Deal [2D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target.

(Target: Post-Action): The target takes [Decay: (INT base)].

(Target: Pre-Action): The target's [Initiative] becomes 0. This effect lasts until the end of the round.

A special skill that pierces the enemy's vital points with precision like passing a needle through, hindering their actions. An enemy deprived of freedom becomes a shrike's premature sacrifice waiting to be pierced and pecked by a branch.
